questions.prompt: Which empire controlled Egypt immediately before the British?
questions.fact: Egypt remained nominally Ottoman for decades after Britain occupied it, a fiction both sides found convenient.

questions.prompt: What is the term for a substance dissolved in a solution?
questions.fact: Water dissolves more substances than any other liquid, which is why it is called the universal solvent.

questions.prompt: Which country has won the most Olympic medals in judo?
questions.fact: It was added to the Games in 1964, the year Tokyo first hosted, and a Dutch fighter promptly won the open category.

questions.prompt: Which film features the fictional Bates Motel?
questions.fact: Cinemas were instructed not to admit anyone after the film began, which was unheard of at the time.

questions.prompt: Which country contains most of the Kalahari Desert?
questions.fact: Roughly seventy percent of the country is covered by it, yet it supports substantial wildlife.

questions.prompt: Who wrote the novel Brave New World's non-fiction follow-up, Brave New World Revisited?
questions.fact: Written twenty-six years later, it argues his predictions were arriving faster than he had expected.

questions.prompt: What does the acronym JSON stand for?
questions.fact: Despite the name it is language-independent, and most languages that use it are not JavaScript.
